outcome: Use of infant formula in hospital
cohort: 700 women recruited from three public and two private maternity hospitals in Shiraz, Iran
finding: Despite Baby-Friendly designation, many hospitals did not adhere to all 10 Steps, and cesarean delivery and lack of early skin-to-skin contact were associated with in-hospital feeding practices that could negatively impact breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by cesarean section were more likely to experience delayed breastfeeding and receive formula compared to those delivered vaginally.
